covers: Simulated ML platform showback, calendar year 2025, five allocation policies; not paid invoices.

metrics.definition: Annual simulated platform cost under the usage allocation policy; all teams including unallocated
metrics.name: platform_usage_cost
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM showback WHERE method = 'usage'

columns.definition: Simulated calendar month in YYYY-MM form
columns.name: month

columns.definition: Allocated team, including the explicit unallocated owner
columns.name: team

columns.definition: Allocation policy. Policies are alternatives and must never be added together.
columns.name: method

columns.definition: Effective simulated platform cost in USD under this policy, converted exactly from integer microdollars
columns.name: cost_usd

tables.description: One row per team, month and allocation policy. Select exactly one method before summing dollars.
tables.name: showback
